levels.name: Remember
levels.description: Retrieve relevant knowledge from long-term memory (recognise, recall).

levels.name: Understand
levels.description: Construct meaning: interpret, exemplify, classify, summarise, infer, compare, explain.

levels.name: Apply
levels.description: Carry out or use a procedure in a given situation (execute, implement).

levels.name: Analyze
levels.description: Break material into parts and determine how they relate (differentiate, organise, attribute).

levels.name: Evaluate
levels.description: Make judgements based on criteria and standards (check, critique).

levels.name: Create
levels.description: Put elements together into a new coherent whole or original product (generate, plan, produce).
